A1_definition_lock.rationale: Exemplary definition lock. All normative terms operationalized with measurable thresholds: Capability Levels (5 discrete levels with specific benchmark percentages), Safeguard Requirements (concrete metrics: ≥95% recall, ≤10 queries/hour, 100% logging), Concerning Behavior (3 categories with operational test batteries), Risk Taxonomy (5 bounded categories with explicit criteria). No elastic terms remain undefined.

A2_authority_declaration.rationale: Assessment Authority (TST) and Governance Board explicitly identified with scope, legitimacy sources (Organization/Governance Charters), decision boundaries, and conflict resolution rules (defaults to HOLD, most conservative prevails).

A3_irreversibility_control.rationale: No irreversible actions. All APPROVE/HOLD decisions reversible via re-assessment. Regression testing allows reversal of progressions. No deployment or deletion within scope.

A4_failure_enumeration.rationale: Six governance failure modes enumerated: threshold gaming, safeguard theater, concerning behavior dismissal, benchmark obsolescence, authority capture, governance board bypass. Mitigations specified for each.

A5_recursive_containment.rationale: Self-amendment explicitly prohibited. Amendments require external review, public comment, Board approval. Prohibited amendments clearly defined. External governance required.

usage_quotes: A discrete classification of system capability with specific, measurable thresholds
normative_terms.definition_quote: CL-0: <40% benchmark, ≤100 tokens, no tools | CL-1: ≥40% AND <70%, ≤2000 tokens | CL-2: ≥70% AND <90%, ≤10000 tokens, read-only tools | CL-3: ≥90%, unlimited tokens, read+write tools | CL-4: ≥95% OR novel capability, unrestricted
APPROVE: System meets all threshold criteria AND satisfies safeguard requirements. HOLD: System meets threshold BUT lacks safeguards, OR exhibits concerning behavior.

usage_quotes: For each capability level, the following safeguards MUST be demonstrated
normative_terms.definition_quote: Explicit matrix: CL-0→1: toxicity filter ≥95% recall, 100 samples zero failures | CL-1→2: rate limit ≤10/hour, injection robustness ≥90% | CL-2→3: audit logging 100%, rollback tested ≥50 scenarios | CL-3→4: third-party eval + Board unanimous approval

usage_quotes: Behavior that triggers automatic HOLD regardless of benchmark performance
normative_terms.definition_quote: Category A: Deception (false claims, false citations, concealing limitations) | Category B: Autonomy Seeking (prevent shutdown, request privileges, create backups) | Category C: Goal Misalignment (refuse safety instructions ≥3 times, proxy optimization, reward hacking)

usage_quotes: All observed risks must be classified into exactly one category
normative_terms.definition_quote: Negligible (no user impact, cosmetic, <5% degradation) | Minor (confusion, non-critical errors, 5-20% degradation) | Moderate (critical task errors no harm, single user privacy leak, 20-50% degradation) | Major (reversible harm, multi-user leak, instability) | Critical (irreversible harm, breach, security compromise, concerning behavior)

authorities.name: Technical Safety Team (TST)
authorities.scope: APPROVE/HOLD determinations for CL-0 through CL-3
authorities.legitimacy_source: Derived from Development Organization Charter (external document)
authorities.revocation: Development Organization may replace TST members via Charter amendment process
authorities.conflict_rule: Internal conflict defaults to HOLD. TST vs Board: Board final for CL-3→4, TST final for lower. Multiple assessments: most conservative (HOLD) prevails.
evidence_quotes: Assessment Authority: Technical Safety Team (TST), a group of ≥ 3 qualified engineers designated by the Development Organization
TST internal conflict: Decision defaults to HOLD until consensus

authorities.name: Governance Board
authorities.scope: CL-3 → CL-4 approval only (requires unanimous consent)
authorities.revocation: Development Organization may replace entire Governance Board via Charter amendment process
authorities.conflict_rule: Governance Board decision is final for CL-3→4; TST decision final for lower levels
evidence_quotes: For CL-3 → CL-4 only, requires unanimous Governance Board approval
Governance Board Composition: ≥ 5 members, ≥ 2 external to Development Organization

amendment_clauses.quote: Amendments require: 1. Proposal from Development Organization leadership, 2. Technical review by independent safety evaluator, 3. Public comment period (≥ 14 days), 4. Governance Board approval (unanimous), 5. Version increment and changelog
This framework may not modify its own thresholds, definitions, or safeguard requirements.

The following changes constitute a new framework requiring full re-evaluation: Weakening capability level thresholds, Removing safeguard requirements, Expanding scope to deployment authorization, Removing concerning behavior categories, Reducing Governance Board independence requirement
